nodes.description: uint256 public startingIndexBlock; block number recorded for pseudo-random starting index computation
uint256 public startingIndex; derived from blockhash and MAX_PASSPORTS
uint256 public constant pupPrice = 80000000000000000 (0.08 ETH) used for mint payment checks
uint public constant maxPurchase = 20; per-transaction mint cap
uint256 public MAX_PASSPORTS; total supply cap set in constructor
bool public saleIsActive = false; gate for minting
address private _owner in Ownable; controls onlyOwner functions
EnumerableMap.UintToAddressMap _tokenOwners; tokenId to owner registry in ERC721
mapping(address => EnumerableSet.UintSet) _holderTokens; per-owner token sets
mapping(uint256 => address) _tokenApprovals; per-token approvals
mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) _operatorApprovals; operator approvals
string private _baseURI; prefix for token URI resolution
withdraw() public onlyOwner; sends entire contract balance to owner via transfer
setBaseURI(string) public onlyOwner; forwards to ERC721._setBaseURI
flipSaleState() public onlyOwner; toggles saleIsActive
burn(uint256) public; checks approval/ownership then calls _burn
mintPassport(uint256) public payable; payable public minting entry point with price/supply checks and _safeMint loop
setStartingIndex() public; computes startingIndex from blockhash(startingIndexBlock) modulo MAX_PASSPORTS
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock() public onlyOwner; sets startingIndexBlock to current block.number
transferOwnership(address) public onlyOwner; changes _owner
renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner; sets _owner to zero address
_msgSender() internal view; returns msg.sender
_transfer(address,address,uint256) internal; core ERC721 state mutation for token movement
_mint(address,uint256) internal; creates token, updates holder and owner registries
_safeMint(address,uint256,bytes) internal; mints then performs receiver callback check (external call)
_burn(uint256) internal; clears approvals/metadata and removes token from registries
_checkOnERC721Received(...) private; performs external functionCall to recipient contract
_approve(address,uint256) internal; writes _tokenApprovals
ownerOf(uint256) public view; reads _tokenOwners
_isApprovedOrOwner(address,uint256) internal view; authorization check for transfers/burns
totalSupply() public view; returns _tokenOwners.length()
_setBaseURI(string) internal; writes _baseURI
_beforeTokenTransfer(address,address,uint256) internal virtual hook invoked on mint/transfer/burn
setApprovalForAll(address,bool) public; writes _operatorApprovals for _msgSender()
approve(address,uint256) public; owner/operator checked approval entry point
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for payment, minting recipient, burns and ownership checks
msg.sender.transfer(balance) in withdraw(): external value transfer to owner-controlled address before any state update
to.functionCall(abi.encodeWithSelector(onERC721Received,...)) in _checkOnERC721Received: arbitrary external call to recipient during safe mint/transfer
numberOfTokens parameter of mintPassport
loop counter i in mintPassport
mintIndex = totalSupply() inside mintPassport loop
tokenId parameter of burn
baseURI parameter of setBaseURI
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership
balance = address(this).balance in withdraw
to parameter of _mint
tokenId parameter of _mint
to parameter of _checkOnERC721Received used as external call target
_data parameter forwarded in the onERC721Received call
returndata bytes from the external onERC721Received call in _checkOnERC721Received

edges.reason: Owner-controlled msg.sender receives the full contract balance through an external transfer in withdraw
withdraw executes msg.sender.transfer(balance), an external value transfer
withdraw is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender()
msg.sender determines whether the onlyOwner check on withdraw passes
mintPassport is public payable and msg.sender is the recipient of minted passports
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is onlyOwner and compares owner() to _msgSender()
transferOwnership is onlyOwner and therefore depends on msg.sender authorization
flipSaleState is onlyOwner and depends on msg.sender authorization
mintPassport requires saleIsActive before minting
mintPassport requires numberOfTokens <= maxPurchase
mintPassport checks totalSupply plus numberOfTokens against MAX_PASSPORTS
mintPassport multiplies pupPrice by numberOfTokens to validate msg.value
mintPassport calls totalSupply() for supply checks and mint index derivation
mintPassport calls _safeMint in a loop, triggering an external receiver call
mintPassport writes startingIndexBlock when it is still zero
setStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock as the blockhash seed
setStartingIndex takes blockhash modulo MAX_PASSPORTS
setStartingIndex writes the derived startingIndex
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes startingIndexBlock and is restricted by onlyOwner
setBaseURI forwards the new value to _setBaseURI
_setBaseURI writes the _baseURI state variable
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable under onlyOwner
_safeMint first mints the token via _mint then performs the receiver check
_safeMint reaches the external onERC721Received call path through _checkOnERC721Received
_checkOnERC721Received executes to.functionCall(onERC721Received selector) allowing control transfer to the recipient
burn requires _isApprovedOrOwner(_msgSender(), tokenId) before burning
burn delegates to the internal _burn implementation
_isApprovedOrOwner calls ownerOf to resolve the current token owner
ownerOf reads the _tokenOwners mapping
totalSupply returns _tokenOwners.length()
_burn clears approvals by calling _approve(address(0), tokenId)
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_transfer clears the previous approval via _approve(address(0), tokenId)
_transfer removes and adds token ids in _holderTokens
_transfer updates the _tokenOwners map with the new owner
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_mint adds the token id to the recipient's _holderTokens set
_mint writes the token id to _tokenOwners
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_approve writes the _tokenApprovals mapping
setApprovalForAll writes _operatorApprovals for _msgSender()
approve performs its authorization checks then calls _approve
transferOwnership writes _owner and is guarded by onlyOwner
renounceOwnership clears _owner and is guarded by onlyOwner
numberOfTokens parameter drives mint loop count, supply and price checks
loop counter i controls iteration of the mint loop in mintPassport
mintIndex derived from totalSupply() is passed as the tokenId to _safeMint
tokenId parameter of burn is used in the approval check and _burn
baseURI parameter of setBaseURI is forwarded to _setBaseURI
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership is validated and written to _owner
balance local holds address(this).balance that is transferred to msg.sender
to parameter of _mint becomes the recipient owner entry
tokenId parameter of _mint is written into the owner registries
to parameter of _checkOnERC721Received is the untrusted target of the external functionCall
_data parameter is abi-encoded into the onERC721Received call payload
external call return value is captured in returndata and decoded as bytes4
returndata comparison against _ERC721_RECEIVED decides the success of _checkOnERC721Received
_msgSender returns msg.sender, exposing the untrusted caller to callers such as burn and setApprovalForAll

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfTokens is only meaningful as the mint count argument of mintPassport
loop counter i exists only to drive the mintPassport mint loop
mintIndex is the tokenId argument passed from mintPassport into _safeMint
tokenId parameter is consumed entirely by the burn entry point
baseURI parameter is directly forwarded by setBaseURI to _setBaseURI
newOwner parameter is the sole argument written to _owner by transferOwnership
balance is the amount passed into the msg.sender.transfer unsafe operation
to parameter of _mint is written directly into the token registries
tokenId parameter of _mint is written directly into the token registries
to parameter is the untrusted target address of the external onERC721Received call
_data parameter is encoded into the external call payload
returndata holds the raw result of the external call and is decoded for the return check
